Actor Runtime ID.description: The runtime id of the actor being moved.

Force Completion.description: Whether the receiver should complete any in-progress local movement before applying this update.

Force Move.description: Whether the receiver should snap the actor to the new position without interpolation.

Force Move Local Entity.description: Whether the receiver should snap a locally-owned entity to the new position.

Is On Ground.description: Whether the actor is on the ground after applying this update.

New Position X.description: New X coordinate of the actor; absent when X position has not changed.

New Position Y.description: New Y coordinate of the actor; absent when Y position has not changed.

New Position Z.description: New Z coordinate of the actor; absent when Z position has not changed.

Rotation X.description: New X rotation packed as int8; absent when X rotation has not changed.

Rotation Y.description: New Y rotation packed as int8; absent when Y rotation has not changed.

Rotation Y Head.description: New head Y rotation packed as int8; absent when head Y rotation has not changed or the actor is not a Mob.
